name: trophyquest-psn-fetcher

scripts.build: npm run build-fetcher && npm run build-refresher
scripts.build-fetcher: esbuild src/fetcher.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/fetcher.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build-refresher: esbuild src/refresher.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/refresher.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"

description: Functions to retrieve PSN data with [`psn-api`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/psn-api)
